key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) adapts prediction sets when delayed feedback and limited tracking capacity would otherwise undermine long-term risk guarantees.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging AI, this approach could support uncertainty quantification when outcome feedback arrives late and not every prediction can be tracked.
method: Randomly samples a proxy delay to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Uses inverse probability weighting to account for feedback lost through delays or capacity limits.
Optimizes tracking policies using risk bounds that balance feedback collection against capacity saturation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical risk bounds and experiments spanning medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Long-term risk guarantees do not establish per-patient safety; clinical deployment would require validation under local feedback delays and tracking constraints.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
